_doc: Our own animations, baked by tools/make_anims.gd onto the shared skeletons (kit/chars/derived/anims_<sex>.res, library 'own'). See docs/personajes.md, 'Animaciones propias'. Positions and directions in the character's space: feet on y = 0, facing +z, its left = +x. Items: hand-held ones are defined in the fist's grip frame (+z = along the handle towards the thumb, +y = along the fingers, origin in the fist); others are placed on a bone with 'at'/'rot' in character space.

masks._doc: Bone sets of a layer (the upper animation of CharBuilder 'carry'): glob patterns of bone names.

hammer._doc: Hammering on the anvil: impact (sharp, accelerating in), rebound, slow raise, short hang at the top. Tongs hold the piece. Staggered stance (left foot forward); the weight rides the swing: hips back and up with the right shoulder on the raise, down and forward with the knees on the hit. Anvil face y 0.81, centre z 0.56.

carry_box._doc: Upper body: a crate held in front with both hands on its sides. Layer over Walk / Idle (mask arms).

sweep._doc: Sweeping with a besom: the brush drags right to left on the floor, lifts a little on the way back. Hands near the hip and the chest.

saw._doc: Sawing a plank on a bench (top 0.80): the blade slides through the kerf, push (cutting) and pull; the left hand holds the plank. Shoulder rocks with the push.

stir._doc: Stirring the cauldron (rim 0.82) with a long paddle: the blade circles in the pot, the hands follow on a smaller circle; the body sways a little behind.

hoe._doc: Hoeing: the left hand holds the end of the handle, the right one 32 cm down it. Staggered stance (left foot forward). Raise over the right shoulder with the weight on the back foot and the hips turned right, accelerate down (sharp) with the weight going onto the front foot and the knees bending, the blade bites 3 cm, drag it back toward the feet, raise again. The right hand loosens on the way up and tightens before the hit (fingers close index first).

sit_bench._doc: Sitting_Idle moved so the butt rests on a 0.45 m seat (measured on the skinned legs); feet kept on the floor with IK.

sit_stool._doc: Sitting_Idle on a 0.59 m stool (the Fantasy Props Stool): same correction, the feet still reach the floor.

drink._doc: Seated on a 0.45 m bench: lifts the tankard from the table (top 0.72), drinks with the head back, puts it down.

count_coins._doc: At a counter (top 0.95): the right hand slides coins one by one from the pile to the left; the left hand rests flat.

bow._doc: A bow (for nobles): hips back, spine and neck forward, right hand to the chest, left arm a little out; holds and straightens up. Not a loop.

carry_wave._doc: Upper layer (right arm): waving hello, the hand rocks side to side. Over Idle or Walk.

carry_sack._doc: Upper layer (right arm): a sack over the right shoulder, held in front by the right hand. The left arm keeps swinging with the walk.

carry_baby._doc: Upper layer (arms): a swaddled baby across the chest, head in the left arm, right hand on its front.

carry_cane._doc: Upper layer (right arm) over Walk, same cycle length: the cane tip is planted while the left foot is (Walk 0.08-0.75 s, moving back at the foot's speed) and swings forward with it. Slower walk (speed 0.75). Standing: carry_cane_idle.

carry_cane_idle._doc: Upper layer (right arm) standing: the cane planted beside the right foot, leaning on it a little.

sleep_back._doc: Asleep on the back on a bed: the root on the mattress (y = 0 is the mattress top), head towards -z (the head of the bed), under a blanket that comes with it. Slow breathing.

cut_cloth._doc: Cutting cloth with shears on the cutting table (top 0.86): the right hand snips forward along the line (the fingers close on each cut), the left holds the cloth flat and follows.

sew._doc: Sewing on a stool (seat 0.45), the work on the lap: the right hand pushes the needle through and draws the thread up and out in a long arc; the left holds the cloth.

eat._doc: Seated on a 0.45 m bench at a table (top 0.76): the spoon goes from the bowl to the mouth and back; the left hand rests by the bowl. The bowl comes with it.

serve._doc: Behind the bar (top 1.05): lifts the jug, pours into the tankard that stands on the bar, sets it down; the left hand on the bar steadies the tankard.

weave._doc: At the loom (breast beam 0.97): the right hand passes the shuttle through the shed to the left and back, then both hands pull the beater against the cloth and push it away.

plane._doc: Planing a board on the bench (top 0.86): both hands on the plane, a long push with the body lunging forward, lifted back on the return.

knead._doc: Kneading in the trough (rim 0.8): the heels of both hands push the dough down and away, then fold it back; the body rocks into each push.

peel._doc: Loaf into the oven with the long peel: the right hand at the end of the handle by the hip, the left 0.4 m up it; a long push into the mouth (0.86), a little shake, and out.

carve._doc: Carving a block on the banker (block top ~0.85): the left hand sets the chisel on the stone, the right strikes it with the mallet (short, sharp blows).

sharpen._doc: At the grindstone (wheel top ~0.68): the blade laid on the wheel, the right hand on the hilt, the left pressing the flat; it slides along the edge, back and forth.

tend._doc: By a cot (top 0.48): bent over the sick, the right hand dabs the forehead with a cloth, the left leans on the edge of the cot; now and then straightens a little.

saw_low._doc: Sawing a board laid on the sawhorses (top 0.67): the saw anim 10 cm lower, more bent at the hips and knees.

chop._doc: Felling with the axe: the right hand at the butt of the handle, the left slides down it on the swing (0.42 -> 0.14 m). Raised over the right shoulder with the hips turned right, a sharp diagonal blow into the trunk at chest height (tip y 0.95, z 0.9), rebound, slow raise. Staggered stance, the weight goes onto the front foot on the hit.

dig._doc: Digging with the shovel: the left hand at the top of the handle, the right 0.4-0.55 m down the shaft. The blade in the ground at the feet (deep bend, knees down), lever it back, lift the load with the blade face up, toss it to the right with a twist of the hips, back to the ground.

mow._doc: Mowing with the scythe: the left hand at the top of the snath by the left hip, the right 0.45 m down it; the blade sweeps on the ground from the right to the left (tip driven, y 0.05) while the hips and the trunk twist from -22 to +20 degrees, then it comes back raised a little.

reap._doc: Reaping with the sickle, bent from the hips with the knees down: the left hand grabs a handful of stalks (y 0.38, z 0.7), the sickle hooks in behind them and cuts with a sharp pull back to the right; the left lifts the bundle and drops it to the left, then grabs again.

pitch._doc: Tossing hay with the pitchfork: the left hand at the butt, the right 0.35-0.45 m up the shaft. Scoop low in front with the tines up, lift, a sharp toss up and to the left with the hips, follow through, back down.

write._doc: Writing with the quill standing at a sloping desk (the page at y 0.93, z 0.43): two lines from the writer's left to the right (towards -x), a dip in the inkpot that stands on the desk at the writer's right, the left hand flat on the page, the head follows the pen.

write_sit._doc: Writing seated (0.45 m) at a table (top 0.76): the same two lines and the dip as `write`, the inkpot on the table at the right, the left hand flat on the page.

carry_bucket._doc: Right arm layer over Walk / Idle: a wooden bucket hangs from the fist at the side, the arm straight, the knuckles down (the bucket is turned so it hangs along the fingers).

carry_torch._doc: Right arm layer over Walk / Idle: a torch held up in front of the shoulder, the flame above the head.

carry_lantern._doc: Right arm layer over Walk / Idle: a hand lantern hangs from the fist at the side, a little forward, the knuckles down.

fish._doc: Fishing: the body turned a quarter to the right, the rod in the right hand at its butt by the right hip and the left hand 0.3 m up it, pointing forward almost level so the line hangs to the water (the float near y 0.1, 1.6 m ahead); a slow bob and a shift of the weight, the eyes on the float.

guard._doc: Standing guard: the spear planted, held upright in the right hand at chest height (the fist 1.15 m up the shaft: the butt on the ground), the round shield on the left forearm held before the chest, its face forward; the weight shifts slowly from foot to foot over the Idle breathing.

roll_dough._doc: Rolling dough on a table (top 0.78): both hands on the handles of the rolling pin (the left 0.42 m along it), it rolls away and back with the body leaning into the push.

ladle._doc: Serving with the ladle at the cauldron (rim 0.82, centre z 0.6): a stir in the pot, the ladle comes up level, pours into the bowl held in the left palm, goes back in.
